projects.name: Image Generation via Prompt-Based Guidance
projects.summary:
Developed a fully automated user-driven T2I framework using prompt engineering; discovered major limitations in diffusion-based models for complex object generation. Introduced a novel CAS metric and achieved visual flaw
detection accuracy by nearly 240% (0.54 vs. 0.16) over the CLIP baseline across four vehicle categories.
